0: Pickup deadlines refer to your current run through the Prologue.
Source-bounded coverage, not a guarantee that every optional pickup has been found.
2: Covers all six Part II chapters from published walkthroughs — not a guarantee that nothing else can be missed.
Some notes apply only when a particular lord leads Part II; they appear once you choose that lord in More.
Support conversations can be viewed at the inn during the preparations of Chapters 1–4.
Guides disagree on one recruitment method; that note is marked uncertain.
3: Part III is split into six numbered sections; “Chapter” here means those sections.
Quests are documented through 6 June. A quest’s first chapter isn’t its deadline — check each note.
Some quests depend on which Part I paths you completed; they appear once those paths are marked in More.
A few notes have conflicting sources and are marked uncertain. Coverage is source-based, not a guarantee.
